compressed.note: Same job list with idle gaps scaled by 0.2. Real-day energy needs measured idle power times the real idle time added back; the 10-hour real-time day is the reference.

review.note: what got done, what moves to tomorrow

task.note: ref is a development-split case id; null when the family has too few cases yet (see missing)
